summary: DB-FIRST engine + honest AI labeling FULLY VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend 3/3 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_db_first.py PASS (10.09s): (A) POST /api/ai/research with a fresh part number -> from_database=false, verification='Requires Verification', approval_status='Pending', result has status/cross_reference/confidence keys and compatible_models/vehicles fallback; (B) POST /api/ai/research/{id}/approve with edits {compatible_vehicles:['Hyundai Creta'], ...} -> GET /api/parts/{pn} shows verification_status='Verified' with the exact admin-edited vehicles=['Hyundai Creta'] and edited name/variant; (C) POST /api/ai/research again on same PN -> from_database=true, verification='Verified', confidence=100, approval_status='Approved', result.status='SUCCESS', result.compatible_vehicles=['Hyundai Creta'] — returned in <5s under a 30s timeout that would trip if AI were called, confirming it did NOT invoke Gemini. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844) admin login abdul/Salam@123 + fresh PN UI-DBF-<ts>: (1) tapping 'Run AI Research' rendered AI card with YELLOW 'Requires Verification' chip (NOT green Verified) + 'Pending' chip + Confidence meter + Cross-ref row (empty for random PN) + 'Review, Edit & Approve' + 'Reject' buttons; (2) after tap Review-Edit-Approve, modal opens pre-filled, changed compatible_vehicles to 'Hyundai Creta', tapped Save -> toast 'AI research complete', AI card re-renders with 'Verified' + 'Approved' chips, Confidence 100%, Vehicles='Hyundai Creta', DB-tag 'તમારી Verified Library માંથી (100%)' — matching backend Behavior C; (3) tapping 'Re-run AI' returned instantly with Verified/Approved/100%/DB-tag still shown. No backend errors, no frontend red screen, no react-native issues detected in this flow. Two pre-existing dev-only warnings observed (harmless): props.pointerEvents deprecated, Animated useNativeDriver JS fallback (already noted in iter 3). No new issues to fix.

context_for_next_testing_agent: TestIDs used: login-username, login-password, login-submit, run-ai, rerun-ai, ai-edit-approve, ai-reject, edit-vehicles, save-edit. To exercise DB-first correctly always use a FRESH part number per run (Behavior A must go through Gemini first). test_db_first.py::TestDbFirstEngine is order-dependent (A->B->C) since it stores pn/rid as class attrs — pytest-xdist runs it in a single worker, do not parallelize its 3 tests.
